meta.name: remix-apple-notes-ad-from-sample
meta.description: Remix a published Apple Notes video ad from the Goose Ads library for a new brand — keep the source's note structure and typing pacing, swap in the brand's product, voice, and promo code, get the note approved in-session, then render with create-apple-notes-video-ad and publish the MP4 back to Gooseworks with live stage reporting. The Apple Notes typing-reveal counterpart to remix-imessage-ad-from-sample; this is what the app's Apple Notes format tab calls.
